findings.claim: Step 5 and the reworded every-release-has-notes now add a gap by hand to both the published Release (gh release edit --notes-file) and the committed .github/release-notes/TAG.md, keep the reviewed text, fix release_notes.py only when the draft missed a change, and forbid regenerating published notes. r3 and r4 test this.

Step 4 now finds the release-tag run for the merge commit, follows it with gh run watch, and reads its ::warning:: and step summary of late commits before gh release view. This matches release-per-package's late-commit design. r4 tests it.
